module: Flowgraph node "Complete Scenario" (category once_instant). Ends the current scenario via scenario_scenarios.finish. Input pins: reason (final message) and fail (bool, if true the scenario fails). Without reason, the message is "Failed" or "Completed".
notes: Does nothing if scenario_scenarios is not loaded.
On failure the table passed contains failed = reason, otherwise msg = reason.

workOnce.desc: Calls scenario_scenarios.finish({failed=...}) or ({msg=...}) depending on fail.
